title: Aparna CyberZed — 3 BHK Apartments, Osman Nagar
description: New launch luxury residential project at Osman Nagar, Hyderabad. 759 units across 3 high-rise towers (S+38/39 floors) spread over 6.4 acres. 3 BHK apartments ranging from 1471 to 2001 sq ft at Rs 7,999 per sq ft. RERA approved — P01100011037. Targeting buyers looking for premium homes close to the financial district and Kokapet growth corridor. Cab pickup arranged for site visits.

title: Aparna Moonstone — Ultra-Luxury 3 & 4 BHK, Gopanpally
description: Ultra-luxury gated community at Gopanpally, Gachibowli — Hyderabad's prime IT corridor. 2,088 units across 8 towers of G+44 floors on a 22-acre township. 3 BHK (2166–2800 sq ft) and 4 BHK (2800–3140 sq ft) configurations. Premium finishes, expansive clubhouse, landscaped greens. Positioned in the heart of the Gachibowli-Nanakramguda financial district. RERA: P02400009478. Site visits by cab arranged from anywhere in Hyderabad.

title: Aparna Newlands — 2.5 & 3 BHK Apartments, Tellapur
description: Premium gated community at Tellapur, Hyderabad — fast-developing suburb near Nallagandla and Financial District. 1,976 units across 8 high-rise towers of 42 floors on 14.7 acres. 2.5 BHK (1475–1600 sq ft) and 3 BHK (1700–1991 sq ft) options. 72,865 sq ft clubhouse with modern amenities, 10 sports courts, designer landscaping. RERA: P01100007480. Cab pickup available from all Hyderabad locations.

title: Aparna Synergy — 2, 2.5 & 3 BHK Apartments, Gandi Maisamma
description: Large-scale affordable luxury community at Gandi Maisamma, Hyderabad — north Hyderabad growth zone near Kompally. 3,345 units across 15 towers of G+27 floors on 28 acres. 2 BHK (1251–1400 sq ft), 2.5 BHK (1500–1700 sq ft), and 3 BHK (1800–2307 sq ft) configurations. 15+ child-centric outdoor amenities. Excellent value for first-time homebuyers and investors. RERA: P02200006615.

title: Aparna Sarovar Zenith — Completed Luxury Project, Nallagandla
description: Completed and delivered luxury residential project at Nallagandla, Hyderabad. Handed over in 2022. A flagship completed project by Aparna Constructions demonstrating their on-time delivery track record. Premium 3 and 4 BHK apartments with lake-facing views. Residents from this project are the strongest testimonials for Aparna's quality and timely delivery.
